prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: conceptual portfolio project cover artwork.
Create a premium cinematic 3D editorial still life, landscape 1536×1024 or similar exact 3:2 proportion. Sophisticated studio lighting, polished tactile metal and translucent colored glass, a richly detailed but uncluttered designed sculpture. Full bleed with no frame. Keep every important form within the central 75% of the canvas so both 16:10 and 2:1 crops work. High-end coherent material treatment and meticulous physically plausible light/refractions, art-directed impossible sculpture.
Constraints: No words, numbers, labels, UI screenshots, logos, watermarks, literal code, or photos of people. This is a conceptual artwork, not a depiction of an actual product interface. No typography or symbols resembling lettering.
Subject: Conversational analytics, natural-language to validated SQL at huge scale, expressed as one elegant impossible data sculpture. Emerald glass ribbons made from many luminous data particles flow into a precise transparent architectural cube/data monolith, resolving into neat orderly columns on the opposite side.
Art direction: Dark forest green #173b2d, chartreuse highlights, smoked emerald glass and brushed silver. Creamy light studio background with deep green shadows. One clear central subject, dynamic diagonal three-quarter perspective, beautiful contrast between the fluid incoming ribbons and precisely organized outgoing columns. Show an emotionally satisfying transformation from organic flowing information to structured order. No text, grids resembling a UI, labels, or actual SQL.
